classification.difficultyReason: Pythagoras in the right triangle gives half the chord, then the perpendicular bisects the chord, so double it. Scaffolded by the right-angle mark and the instruction to use Pythagoras.

content.prompt: Find the length $AB$. Use Pythagoras’ Theorem.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}AM^2&=OA^2-OM^2\\AM^2&=15^2-9^2\\AM^2&=144\\AM&=12\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord.
$$\begin{align*}AB&=2\times12\\AB&=24\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
